exemptions.test_an_sd_in_detail_survives_the_gates_: A precondition, not this file's claim: a FAIL verdict at an unchanged fingerprint is warn-only and returns None. That behaviour is the gate's, pinned by tests/handoffs/test_goal_gate.py::TestChainCap::test_chain_cap_row_fingerprint_unchanged_no_redispatch; it is asserted here only so the rewrite that follows is the warn path's.
